title: The Limits of Simulated Societies: How Post-Training and Survey Fine-Tuning Erase Cross-Cultural Variance
reasoning: The paper explicitly evaluates LLM responses to the World Values Survey, which includes morally charged and culturally sensitive questions (e.g., whether wife-beating or homosexuality are justifiable) and inquiries about religious importance and confidence in churches/mosques. It studies how alignment and post-training cause models to collapse onto normatively 'correct' ethical answers and lose cross-cultural variation in moral and religious beliefs.
